# Gilbert Blythe

## Overview

- **Age:** Early twenties (around 21-22 at the end of Volume 2)
- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island, Canada
- **Role:** Schoolteacher; aspiring medical student
- **Titles:** Teacher at White Sands School
- **Nicknames:** Gil

## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall, handsome young man with hazel eyes and curly brown hair. He possesses an expressive, intelligent face and a cheerful, confident smile that makes him popular among his peers. As he matures from a boy into a young adult, he develops a manly and distinguished carriage.

## Personality

Gilbert is intelligent, witty, and charming, with a strong sense of humor and a cheerful disposition. He is persistent, deeply loyal, and generous, demonstrated when he selflessly gives up the Avonlea school so Anne can stay near Marilla. Though prone to playful teasing as a boy, he grows into a responsible, hard-working, and chivalrous young man. He holds a deep, patient affection for Anne Shirley and remains steadfast in his friendship.

## Traits

- Intelligent
- Generous
- Witty
- Persistent
- Chivalrous

## Abilities

- Academic excellence and intellect
- Teaching and public speaking
- Organizing community efforts

## Goals

- To earn enough money teaching to pay for his university education at Redmond College
- To study medicine and become a doctor
- To win and maintain the close friendship and affection of Anne Shirley

## History

Gilbert returns to Avonlea School after a period away and immediately notices new student Anne Shirley. When he teases her by calling her 'Carrots' and pulling her red hair, Anne smashes a slate over his head, starting a years-long rivalry as Gilbert tries repeatedly to apologize and earn her forgiveness. Throughout their school years and Queen's Academy studies, Gilbert and Anne compete for top academic honors, though Gilbert's admiration for her only grows. Upon graduating from Queen's with a teacher's license, Gilbert gives up his secured position at the Avonlea school to Anne so she can live at Green Gables after Matthew Cuthbert's death, taking the White Sands school instead. Touched by his sacrifice, Anne finally forgives him, and the two become close friends. Over the next two years while teaching, Gilbert helps form the Avonlea Village Improvement Society alongside Anne and eventually decides to attend Redmond College to pursue a medical degree.

## Background by volume

- Son of John Blythe, who had been an old sweetheart of Marilla Cuthbert in his youth
- Spent time away from Avonlea due to his father's ill health before returning to school

## Affiliations

- Avonlea Village Improvement Society (AVIS) — Member / Executive Officer
- Avonlea School — Student
- Queen's Academy — Student
- White Sands School — Teacher
